fusions.name: Tamped Down
fusions.desc: Brings the head down flat, dealing 15 damage and consuming every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grade the Ground
fusions.desc: Drags the head level across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to everything in it.

fusions.name: Packed-Earth Stance
fusions.desc: Tamps the ground under you: the damage you take falls by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Every Plate
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
